title: Adapt a standard textbook page to every reading level
description: Opus 4.7 reads a single source page in detail and returns a finished file for each audience that needs it.
prompt: From the textbook spread, build me: 1) One slide deck (8–10 slides) covering the core ideas, with the diagram redrawn simply on its own slide 2) Three versions of a one-page reading handout — Level A, B, C — same concepts, different vocabulary and sentence length 3) A short exit-ticket worksheet (3 questions) that checks the standard, same questions for everyone
steps: Describe the task (attach page, standards, rules for each version)
Give Claude context (upload photo/scan, standards/objectives, version rules)
Claude creates the materials (slide deck, handouts, exit ticket)
notes: Page does not show a traditional boxed example prompt; prompt field is the task text presented in the 'Describe the task' step, which is the closest verbatim representation. Extractor reported surface as Claude.ai chat despite Cowork category in manifest. surface corrected to Cowork to match category/features.
